th_unknown: Unknown birth time: only the civil weekday and stable Thai lunar date are shown. Ascendant, houses, planets and Taksa stay unset.

th_locationTitle: Location and coordinates for Thai astrology
th_locationHint: A complete Thai chart requires coordinates. Select a catalog city or enter latitude and longitude if it is not listed.
th_coordsNote: Both coordinates are required. The selected birth time zone is used, including its historical offset.
th_seatNote: Thai coordinates identify provincial seats, not individual hospitals.
th_rulesNote: Traditional Suriyayatra, fixed Anto rising durations and whole-sign houses. Ascendant uses local sunrise; planets use the historical Bangkok +06:42:04 frame. This is one Thai convention; overseas use needs same-school validation.
th_taksaNote: Taksa changes weekday at 06:00. This version does not switch Wednesday night to Rahu. Other schools may differ.
th_transitNote: A snapshot of current Bangkok transits in natal houses. Home readings sample the selected day, week or month separately and apply documented interpretation rules.
th_lensNote: Houses and Taksa below are calculated. Action prompts are editorial and do not guarantee future events or predictive accuracy.
th_chartSymbol: Thai circular chart: Aries at the top, signs counterclockwise. Thai numerals identify planets; red ลั marks the ascendant and * marks Tanuseth.
th_factOnly: Calculated facts, without substituting generic sign personality descriptions for a personal reading.
th_reportBasis: Thai houses and Taksa provide chapter references. The prose is an editorial reflection.
th_lifePractice: Write down what matters most in this area, then choose one small action for the week.
th_noGuarantee: Traditional cultural reference, not evidence of future events.
th_centerSun: Center values show the natal Sun’s degrees and arcminutes within its sign.

f_title: Begin with your birthday. Make room for today.
f_required: Date of birth is required. Time and city are optional.
f_partial: A birthday is enough to begin. Missing time or location stays unknown; we do not infer an ascendant or natal houses.
f_privacy: Guest details stay in this browser and are sent to the local service for calculation, without an account database record. After login, you can confirm saving them to your account.

f_basisAsc: Based on the Thai natal ascendant and whole-sign transit positions.
f_basisSun: Birthday edition: transit positions relative to the Thai Sun sign. These are not natal houses.
f_boundary: Your birth window crosses a Thai Sun sign boundary. Both possibilities are retained; differing results appear as mixed. Add time and city to narrow the window.
f_limits: Positions come from thai-astrology 0.3.2. Suggestions use our versioned rules, not predictions validated by the upstream library. Predictive accuracy has not been established.
f_samplingToday: Today uses transit positions at the calculation minute.
f_samplingDays: Week and month sample each day at noon in Bangkok. One category must reach 60%; otherwise the result is mixed.
f_rules: Suggestion rules: love uses Venus 6 (forward 5/7/11, reflect 6/8/12); money uses Jupiter 5 (2/5/9/11, 6/8/12); family uses Moon 2 (1/4/5/9, 6/8/12); work uses Mercury 4 (3/6/10/11, 8/12). Other positions are steady.

f_work_steady: Finish one manageable task before planning the next step.
f_work_mixed: When tasks change, confirm priorities again and write down commitments.

f_reading_love_supportive: The relationship theme leans toward connection and communication, with room for an honest conversation.
f_reading_love_reflective: The relationship theme leans toward reflection and observation, with a focus on expectations and boundaries.
f_reading_love_steady: The relationship theme favors everyday connection. A gradual pace fits better than rushing to a conclusion.
f_reading_love_mixed: The relationship reference results point in different directions, so it helps to leave room to adjust the pace.
f_reading_money_supportive: The money theme leans toward planning and building reserves, with a focus on arrangements you can carry out.
f_reading_money_reflective: The money theme leans toward review and organization. Existing spending and commitments deserve attention first.
f_reading_money_steady: The money theme favors a steady balance of income and spending, with a budget that works day to day.
f_reading_money_mixed: The money reference results point in different directions, so it helps to leave some room in your budget.
f_reading_family_supportive: The family theme leans toward companionship and cooperation. Small, concrete gestures can support closeness.
f_reading_family_reflective: The family theme leans toward listening and sorting things out, while balancing care for others with your own energy.
f_reading_family_steady: The family theme favors steady everyday connection, supported by small acts of care you can sustain.
f_reading_family_mixed: The family reference results point in different directions, so conversations and plans benefit from flexibility.
f_reading_work_supportive: The work theme leans toward communication and progress, with a focus on turning an idea into a clear next step.
f_reading_work_reflective: The work theme leans toward review and adjustment. Allow extra time to confirm information and hand work over.
f_reading_work_steady: The work theme favors steady progress. Finishing current tasks fits better than opening several new ones at once.
f_reading_work_mixed: The work reference results point in different directions, so confirm priorities before arranging your tasks.
f_week_love_supportive: Set aside one relaxed conversation this week. At the weekend, check whether the pace feels comfortable for both of you.
f_week_love_reflective: Choose a suitable moment this week to explain your expectations, allow time for a reply, and avoid rushing a conclusion.
f_week_love_steady: Keep one small habit of staying in touch this week, with a concrete gesture of care.
f_week_love_mixed: Confirm an arrangement this week, discuss one issue at a time, and adjust plans if views change.
f_week_money_supportive: Check income and fixed costs this week, set a manageable savings goal, and review progress at the weekend.
f_week_money_reflective: Handle essential bills first this week, pause one nonessential expense, and check existing commitments.
f_week_money_steady: Record daily spending this week. At the weekend, choose one expense you can improve sustainably.
f_week_money_mixed: Keep a little room in this week’s budget. If an extra cost comes up, review the budget before deciding.
f_week_family_supportive: Plan a shared meal or time together this week, and agree who will handle one household task.
f_week_family_reflective: Make time to listen without interruption this week, and be clear about the time and tasks you can manage.
f_week_family_steady: Do one small thing together this week, making companionship a habit you can keep.
f_week_family_mixed: Discuss family issues separately this week. Reach one small agreement before moving to the next step.
f_week_work_supportive: Move one important task forward this week, agree on what a finished result looks like, and review progress at the weekend.
f_week_work_reflective: Leave time for checks and handovers this week. Confirm key details before making new commitments.
f_week_work_steady: List three manageable goals this week and work through them in priority order.
f_week_work_mixed: Break work into short steps this week. Confirm priorities before starting and share updates when circumstances change.
f_month_love_supportive: Set a concrete goal for time together this month, plan a few relaxed meetings, and check how you both feel each week.
f_month_love_reflective: Clarify your needs and boundaries this month. Give the relationship time to show its pattern before making a quick decision.
f_month_love_steady: Keep a comfortable rhythm of time together this month, and follow through on one small promise each week.
f_month_love_mixed: Leave flexibility in relationship plans this month. Check in on each other’s expectations before choosing the next step.
f_month_money_supportive: Plan this month’s income, spending and savings. Check the plan weekly and review it at the end of the month.
f_month_money_reflective: List recurring bills and existing payment obligations this month. Address them in stages before adding new commitments.
f_month_money_steady: Keep a sustainable budget this month, check spending weekly, and adjust one spending habit at the end of the month.
f_month_money_mixed: Keep a buffer this month, plan spending in stages, and update the budget weekly as circumstances change.
f_month_family_supportive: Choose one small shared goal this month, make time together each week, and look back on it together at month’s end.
f_month_family_reflective: Discuss how to share chores and caring responsibilities this month, protect time for rest, and adjust one thing at a time.
f_month_family_steady: Continue one manageable family habit this month and leave time for an unhurried conversation each week.
f_month_family_mixed: Handle family matters in stages this month. When plans change, talk before agreeing on a new division of tasks.
f_month_work_supportive: Choose one clear work goal this month, divide it into weekly milestones, and review actual progress at month’s end.
f_month_work_reflective: Address backlogs, processes and handovers this month. Leave room for review before taking on a wider workload.
f_month_work_steady: Keep a steady work rhythm this month, finish one small milestone each week, and collect your results at month’s end.
f_month_work_mixed: Make work commitments in stages this month. Recheck priorities weekly and allow time for changes.

r_intro: Understand your Thai natal chart through its planets, twelve houses, and connecting lines.
r_roles: Goals, intention, and self-expression.｜Feelings, emotional rhythm, and security.｜Action, courage, and handling conflict.｜Communication, thinking, and sharing information.｜Learning, beliefs, and a wider perspective.｜Relationships, taste, and values.｜Responsibility, structure, and sustained effort.｜Desire, unfamiliar experiences, and the pull of change.｜Detachment, reflection, and less visible habits.｜Independence, new perspectives, and breaking patterns.｜Your approach to the world and the starting point of the chart.
r_houseTitles: Self and expression｜Resources and money｜Communication and siblings｜Home and foundations｜Creativity and joy｜Obstacles and responses｜Partnership and cooperation｜Sharing and change｜Learning and beliefs｜Career and public role｜Gains and support｜Losses and retreat
r_houseNotes: Notice how you respond to your surroundings and express yourself.｜Reflect on resources, values, and what supports everyday stability.｜Consider speaking, listening, nearby connections, and practical learning.｜Explore your connection with family, home, and a sense of belonging.｜Make room for creativity, interests, children, and enjoyment.｜Reflect on competition, disagreement, and difficulties that call for a response; do not use this to diagnose illness.｜Observe how you build equal connections with partners and collaborators.｜Consider shared resources and your response to change; this does not predict misfortune.｜Reflect on study, travel, and experiences that broaden your outlook.｜Explore work, responsibility, and how you contribute your abilities.｜Consider gains, results, and support from others as a way to reflect on mutually helpful connections.｜Reflect on spending, depletion, private matters, and solitude without treating them as a prediction of misfortune.
r_planetContext: Read this symbolic theme alongside house {{house}}, the area of “{{theme}}.”
r_emptyNote: An empty house does not mean that area of life is missing or unfavorable. Its ruler still provides context.
r_relationNotes: Explore how the two themes may support each other, without assuming guaranteed ease.｜Notice connections that can be developed through practical cooperation.｜Consider competing needs and ways to adjust your approach.｜Look for balance between two needs rather than labeling them good or bad.
r_natalScope: These are birth-time positions and traditional symbols. Visit your fortune page for daily, weekly, and monthly changes.
r_continue: Bring the reading into your life

r_scope: Positions are calculated from your birth details. Text offers versioned symbolic explanations, not verified future events or a substitute for professional advice.
q_views: Both drawings use the same Thai chart data. They do not switch to Western astrology.
q_difference: First match AM/PM, birth city, time zone, zodiac, and house system. Tropical positions, Placidus houses, and degree-based aspects with orbs follow different rules from this traditional Thai model. A country alone does not determine a precise ascendant.
q_precision: This version uses sunrise and fixed Anto intervals for a traditional ascendant. Overseas results still require independent checking within the same school. Displayed arcminutes describe numerical resolution, not a guarantee of equivalent modern astronomical accuracy.
